messages:
Sam H: FYI — NorthStar Systems sent updated onboarding checklist with HSM firmware v2.1
Maria L: got it, thanks. Are their HSM KMS bindings using pkcs11 or a cloud-kms adapter?
NorthStar PM: We're using PKCS#11 over FIPS module; we can also expose a gRPC adapter if that helps.
Alex P: PKCS11 is fine. Need to confirm our private deployment supports their driver. @Kavita S can you schedule a test run in staging?
Kavita S: On it. I'll spin up a private env tomorrow. Need the driver package + signing key. NorthStar, can you share SHA256 and sig?
NorthStar PM: pushed to secure share: https://files.northstar.example/redsdk/driver-v2.1.sig
PartnerBot: New file uploaded by NorthStar PM (driver-v2.1.sig)
Maria L: Also legal asked for an embargo date for the joint announcement — partners want 2026-05-05. Thoughts?
Sam H: Product OK with that timeline. We need SSO/SAML metadata exchange and SCIM provisioning tests by 2026-04-20 to avoid surprises.
Alex P: For SAML we'll use our enterprise IdP flow (SP-init). I'll send metadata and a sample assertion.
NorthStar PM: We'll run IdP tests on our side the same week. Can you add a SCIM test account pool so we can validate provisioning events?
Kavita S: I'll provision a dedicated SCIM workspace in staging. Please include these endpoints:
```
POST /scim/v2/Users
PATCH /scim/v2/Users/{id}
```
NorthStar PM: ack. We also need KMS key rotation schedule documented — their HSM rotates every 90 days.
Maria L: Ops wants a rollback plan: fallback to cloud-kms with sealed tokens if HSM unavailable. Add to runbook.
Sam H: Good call. Alex, can you add a health check endpoint and a circuit-breaker policy to avoid SLO impact?
Alex P: Adding /health/hsm and a circuit-breaker in front of HSM calls. Will include metrics: hsm_latency_ms, hsm_err_rate
NorthStar PM: We'll coordinate load tests — propose 50 RPS for initial validation.
Kavita S: I'll run load tests on 2026-04-10 in staging and share load artifacts.
Maria L: Ops/security requires a KMS attestation report and HSM cert chain. NorthStar, can you provide the attestation by 2026-04-01?
NorthStar PM: Yes — attestation scheduled for 2026-03-28. We'll upload to the secure share.
Sam H: Marketing: can we get a partner one-pager draft by 2026-04-15 for the announcement playbook?
Maria L: I'll loop in marketing after legal sign-off.
Alex P: Quick NOTE: for private deployments, customers might need to whitelist the partner's IPs. Adding that to setup checklist.
Kavita S: Created a checklist item: IP allowlist + driver install + SCIM creds + SAML metadata exchange.
Sam H: 👍 I'll collate action items and send a weekly cadence. Next sync Thu 10am PT.
NorthStar PM: Thanks everyone! We'll aim to have driver sig and attestation uploaded by end of week.
